ns2:section.sectionText: This section will have distributed attendance. You will receive an email from your instructor with specific attendance instructions. Undergraduate and graduate students may enroll in the BB lecture and in one of the laboratory (BL) sections for 4 hours credit.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Engineering Physics or Physics or Teaching of Physics or Astronomy major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
